title: Bitcoin’s biggest bet is now a drop below $60,000, not a rally above $100,000
content: The $60,000 put has replaced the $100,000 call as bitcoin’s biggest options bet on Deribit, with $900 million in open interest after the recent slide.

title: Did prediction markets call the U.S. midterm election?: State of Crypto

title: Crypto insiders aren't counting on silver linings in Congress' 'lame duck' session

title: XRP crashes to its lowest since November 2024 as money leaves crypto

title: Aster CEO suspects foul play after token plunges 32% in minutes

title: Asian chip stocks tumble ahead of Nvidia Q3 earnings

title: Luxor CEO warns of AI ‘dark forest’ following Bitcoin miner hijack

title: How Wall Street Is Racing to Claim the Onchain Dollar

title: Bitcoin ETFs Lose $2.1 Billion in November as Outflow Streak Hits Seven Days
content: Spot Bitcoin ETFs shed $185.4 million on Friday, their seventh straight day of outflows, pushing November losses to about $2.1 billion as Bitcoin fell toward $64,000.

title: The Week Jensen Huang Fell: How a Spy Scandal Toppled Nvidia’s CEO

title: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and Other AI Giants Face Lawsuit Demanding Development Freeze

title: What Is Canton Network? The Privacy Blockchain Built for Wall Street
